correctness.rationale: Exact normalized section-density and moment formulas; a parameter-uniform, differentiable Fourier inversion gives the fourth-cumulant density coefficient κ(p)/8n with O(n^-2) error. The elementary trigamma bound proves negative log-ratio derivative, the convergent log-gamma series proves negative excess kurtosis, and strict local monotonicity plus an implicit root calculation proves the unique crossover and sharp C*. The actual packaged verifier checks constants and independently integrates finite-n densities. Finite checks are auxiliary, not the proof.

originality.rationale: Brazitikos–Eskenazis give the exact dimension-free p0 and asymptotic diagonal result. König gives only a one-sided sufficient n≥650/(p0-p) and explicitly says 650 is nonoptimal. The new object is the locally unique equality exponent p_n with exact 1/n coefficient and uniform critical-window law. Primary-text and targeted record queries found no direct equal or stronger mathematical statement; historical priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: The sharp finite-size O(1/n) displacement of a recently solved geometric phase boundary is a natural quantitative question. It identifies an explicit exact cutoff coefficient 195.017…, replacing a previously nonsharp factor 650 in the pairwise near-critical comparison, and classifies the entire first-order scaled crossover rather than recomputing the infinite-dimensional p0.
